behavior.validation: Accept exactly the required schema keys in plain passive JSON-compatible objects and dense ordinary arrays, with finite binary64 values and safe integer descriptors; no coercion, defaults, accessors, booleans-as-numbers or retained aliases. Complete static shape/value validation precedes work preflight. Geometric/topology tests run after preflight. Failure throws Error with stable code, no partial result. Outputs are detached. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0. Array lengths must fit 4294967295; unsafe requested growth/work arithmetic gives WORK_LIMIT before allocation. Host resource exhaustion is a host error, not an allocation guarantee. All grid/kernel/element dimensions are positive integers; each corresponding array length/product must fit 4294967295 and match exactly, otherwise INVALID_INPUT before work.
behavior.environment: No RNG, noise, time, rendering, assets, host state, mutation or retained aliases. Data uses caller coordinate/color conventions as specified.
behavior.numerics: Separate IEEE754 binary64 arithmetic, Math.hypot and host sin/cos/sqrt for the named formulas. Check computed numeric intermediates for finiteness and throw NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite results. No epsilon in classification or topology, no adaptive exact predicates or near-degeneracy guarantee. General scalar/coordinate comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; topology, indices, order, booleans and RNG states compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exact JSON output.
behavior.algorithm:
Input {positions,indices,levels,maxWork}; indexed triangles, levels 0..30. Output {positions,indices}.
Allow manifold boundaries. Reject duplicate faces, repeated face vertex, isolated vertex, any edge used
>2 times, inconsistent shared direction, disconnected vertex link/bowtie. Sort undirected edges
lexicographically (minID,maxID) for new-vertex order; sum neighbors in ascending old ID. Interior edge
point=.375(A+B)+.125(C+D); boundary edge midpoint=(A+B)/2. Interior old valence n vertex is
(1-nbeta)V+beta*sum(neighbors), beta=3/16 for n=3 else
(1/n)*(5/8-(3/8+1/4*cos(2pi/n))^2). Boundary old vertex with exactly two boundary neighbors is
.75V+.125(N0+N1). Each source [a,b,c] emits [a,eab,eca],[b,ebc,eab],[c,eca,ebc],[eab,ebc,eca].
Topology validation is required even at level0. Before generation reserve the conservative recurrence specified in behavior.budget;
overflow/excess is WORK_LIMIT. Do not recharge actual counts or reclaim unused allowance. Fixtures: tetra with origin and unit axes, level1 V=10,F=16 and
old origin=(3/16,3/16,3/16); exact single triangle boundary level1 has old positions
[.125,.125,0],[.75,.125,0],[.125,.75,0], edge midpoints [.5,0,0],[0,.5,0],[.5,.5,0] at IDs 3,4,5
(lexicographic edges 01,02,12), and faces [0,3,4],[1,5,3],[2,4,5],[3,5,4]. Studies: soften extruded
silhouette; smooth faceted terrain. Primary:
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/smooth-subdivision-surfaces-based-on-triangles/
behavior.budget: Use conservative counts V=input vertex count,F=input face count and W=0. For each requested refinement level add 2*V+10*F to W, then set V=V+3*F and F=4*F using the prior counts. Finally add V+3*F for final topology validation (also for levels0). All sums/products and every conservative vertex/face count must be safe and representable; otherwise WORK_LIMIT. Require W<=maxWork before generated storage. Do not charge again or reclaim unused allowance from actual E<3F. Per-pass sorting adds logarithmic comparison cost; the budget counts topology/output entries, not milliseconds or every primitive comparison.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export loopSubdivideTriangles3D(input) from packages/javascript/src/loop-subdivide-triangles-3d.js. Other targets deferred.
behavior.topology: All triangle indices must be in range. Geometry may be degenerate, but topology must be an orientable combinatorial 2-manifold with boundary. Each interior vertex link must be a single cycle; a boundary vertex link a single path with exactly two boundary neighbors. Reject disconnected links, duplicate unoriented faces, repeated indices within a face, isolated vertices, edges used more than twice or shared in equal directions, and any other link violation with INVALID_TOPOLOGY. Check input topology even for levels0; check each generated level. Old vertices precede newly created lexicographically ordered edge vertices. Use (1-n*beta)*V+beta*sumNeighborCoordinates, with neighbors ascending original index; boundary expression is0.75*V+0.125*(N0+N1).
